title: AI Product Background Changer | AIVideosUGC
description: Change a product photo background from one clear image. Keep the item recognizable, create a new setting for listings or ads, and avoid another studio shoot.
h1: AI product background changer for a new setting
lead: The bottle is fine. The kitchen behind it is not. Ask for a stone slab, and the photo stays the bottle you sell. One photo is 24 credits, shown before you start.
secondary_keywords: replace the background of a product image
steps_h2: How to Change a Product Background in 3 Simple Steps
steps_lead: The bottle you already photographed is the start.

steps.d: A side-on photo of a soap bottle, with the whole bottle in frame, is enough.
Say stone slab, or a pale wood counter. A short ask keeps the bottle easy to see.
Save the square for the listing, or take the finished photo into an ad.

faq.q: What happens to the old room in my photo?
faq.a: It removes the old room and fills that space with a setting you name. A soap bottle on a messy counter can come back on a gray sweep.

faq.q: Does the AI product background changer include a background library?
faq.a: No. There is no free backdrop library. Describe the surface you want; one photo costs 24 credits, shown before you start, and a failed job returns those credits.

faq.q: What should I check on the first photo?
faq.a: Check whether the soap bottle still looks like the one on your shelf. The credit cost is on screen before the photo is made.

faq.q: What prompt should I use to change a product photo background?
faq.a: Name one surface, such as pale wood under a candle. You get a square with that wood filled in behind the candle.

faq.q: Can the area behind the product become white?
faq.a: Yes. Ask for white and you get a finished photo of the item on white, not an empty cutout. A studio table is a different ask.

faq.q: Can I make a new background for an Etsy photo?
faq.a: Yes. Upload one product photo, name the surface or the room, and download the square. The cost shows before the job starts.
The product should keep its angle and shape. Small printed words can shift, so compare the label with the photo you uploaded.

faq.q: Can I download a transparent product image?
faq.a: No. You download a finished photo with the new setting already filled in. For a plain main photo, make a separate white image.

faq.q: Which settings suit a product photo?
faq.a: Use simple surfaces such as light wood, stone, linen, or one quiet color. A busy scene can make the product harder to see.

faq.q: Can I use the new photo in a paid ad?
faq.a: Yes. The download has no watermark. You can use it for your business. Add any price or offer in your ad editor.

faq.q: Can I choose a seasonal or outdoor setting?
faq.a: Yes. Name one room, one surface, or one outdoor scene, such as a holiday shelf or a shaded table.

faq.q: How is this different from a new photo shoot?
faq.a: A new photo shoot needs space and lights. Here the new setting comes from a photo you already own. If it is blurry, start with [how to take product photos for AI](page:guide-product-photo-tips).

faq.q: Can the new photo become a video?
faq.a: Yes. Open [a page-to-ad tool](page:url-to-video) from a product link, or [a moving clip](page:image-to-video) from the photo. Add a written script, a spoken AI voice, on-screen words, and music. Then publish a tall cut on TikTok, or a square on Meta.

faq.q: Can I edit the photo without another app?
faq.a: Yes. Add a short line of text or crop the photo here, then write that line in another language without opening a separate editor.
